lead: A titled band with its own description and the people who work in it. Stack several and the organisation takes shape — and each band can carry its own tone, which one element holding every department could not do.

people.title: The heading is the department
people.role: and the people head at level four
people.text: So a page of stacked bands reads as one outline rather than as five competing sections.

people.title: The rule belongs to the intro
people.role: not to a divider of its own
people.text: A band with no heading therefore cannot end up with a line hanging above nothing.

people.title: Compact tightens the band
people.role: and drops the line under each name
people.text: For the middle department in a stack of five, where the names are the point and the notes are noise.
